title: Board Schedule — Tenure Waiver on Class H Preferred Stock Dividend Reversals, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The reversal tenure waiver on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rests on the holding's age: a holding issued at least 120 whole months before today has 10 percent waived; at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months has 5 percent waived; a younger holding has none waived.

## Schedule

| Age of the holding (whole months from its issue date to today) | Share of the reversal waived |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 10 percent |
| 60 or more but fewer than 120 | 5 percent |
| Fewer than 60 | None |

Waived percentages are summed into one percentage before it is applied: the reversal is charged at 100 less that sum, divided by 100, and rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

**Edges.** A holding of 59 whole months has none waived; 60 whole months, 5 percent; 119 whole months, 5 percent; 120 whole months, 10 percent.
